verdicts.line: [D5] a click on the label around a Select opens its popover (scour): fixed 14fb951919. jsdom's redirected label click carries `detail: 1`, so React Aria does not open the Select there and that test passes before and after the fix. The failing-first test uses a plain button control and shows the label click pressing it. The label now cancels that click and focuses the button.

[D1] label `htmlFor` kept the generated id when the control brought its own id (scour): fixed 49c603971d. The control now passes its id back to the field through a new optional `FieldSemantics.claim`. That is public API, so the changeset is `minor`, `fix api`.
[D4] the output slot tested `!== undefined` instead of `shows()` (scour): fixed f3d0739658.
[D3] a control that names itself also lost the field's description and error (scour): fixed 86ce8abec0. Only its name and id now give way. A group Field still hands its members nothing.
[D2] `shows()` counted `true` as content, so a valid field read as invalid (scour): fixed cee49a8435.

[D6] a row Field squeezes its label to zero width beside a control that fills the row (scour): fixed 320bf3846a. The label is now `flex: 1 0 auto`, so it keeps its own width and still pushes a fixed-width control to the end. Its test, `Field.row.browser.test.tsx`, is a browser test and did not run here.
